messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING oncall — high RPM spike on model family `zephyrus-13b` detected in us-east-1. 90th pct latency rising, burst of long-context requests. Link: https://internal.metrics/zephyrus-13b?span=5m :rotating_light:

nina patel: acked — I'm on it. Do we have customer-facing errors or just increased latency?

ajay singh: seeing elevated RPM and sustained TPM growth. error-rate up ~1.8% (mostly 429s from downstream quota checks). traffic profile shows a few very large prefix requests (>> 4k tokens) causing KV pressure.```
# recent summary
RPM: 4800 -> 12,300 in 6m
TPM: 120k -> 420k in 10m
avg latency: 210ms -> 950ms
429s: 12 -> 220/min
```

nina patel: ok mitigation plan: 1) temporarily lower per-model RPM/TMP for zephyrus-13b family 2) enable fallback routing to zephyrus-6b for lower-cost/shorter contexts 3) notify impacted customers. Who can apply the rate changes now?

ajay singh: I can. Following the traffic-sculpting runbook — will reduce RPM by ~80% and TPM by ~75% to preserve latencies. Applying patch to quota service now.

ajay singh: ```
# patch
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/quotas/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_family":"zephyrus-13b","rpm":1200,"tpm":100000,"reason":"auto-mitigation: high RPM/TPM spike, reduce to preserve SLOs"}'
```

ajay singh: response: `{ "status":"ok","applied":true,"previous":{"rpm":6000,"tpm":400000},"new":{"rpm":1200,"tpm":100000} }` :white_check_mark:

liz h: heads-up — customer `acme-med` has a few active sessions on zephyrus-13b (prod). I just paged account manager to notify. They might see slower completions or 429s while we sculpt.

nina patel: good call. sam, anything you want to pick up? I'm going to validate model routing and watch SLOs for 15m.

sam w: grabbing handoff — I'll monitor and coordinate customer comms. If latency drops and 429s fall, we'll hold for 30m then gradually raise back. Also will check if any internal jobs are misrouted (batch jobs sometimes hit prod endpoints).

ajay singh: initial telemetry: latency 95th -> 320ms, 429s down to ~18/min. throughput reduced as expected.

nina patel: - document action in incident channel (root cause unknown yet — likely spike in long-context workload). - retain mitigation for 30m or until traffic normalizes. - if customers report errors, escalate to product for targeted reroute.

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook step executed: "per-model-rate-sculpt" by ajay singh at 1890123490. Next check-in due in 15m.

sam w: noted — I've setup a short watch: alerts -> latency>500ms for 5m and 429s>50/min will auto-escalate back to oncall. Also pinged account team for ACME.

nina patel: thanks team. if things look stable at next check, we'll incrementally lift RPM to 2500 -> 3800 over 20m and monitor. leaving handoff with sam. :thumbsup:

sam w: will do. tagging this thread for postmortem if root cause isn't a single customer or job.\/closing handoff at 1890123789 :handshake:
